summary: current-composition-local.py checked `dotnet --version` (run at the repository root, which has no global.json, so the newest SDK under DOTNET_ROOT answers) against the hosted caller's TOOLS.sdk in fable-reference-public.yml (10.0.401) for every route. Templates#829 moved the fable-game template payload to SDK 10.0.403 with rollForward disable, so from then on no single SDK root could pass both the runner's check and the generated workspace's own pin, and --source-built could not run on main. The published route is unaffected, because the published 0.20.1 archive's global.json still pins 10.0.401. Repair (Templates#823, merged a4bc9b11): source-built mode requires the checked-out template's exact global.json pin and records sdkSource checkout-template-global-json; the published route keeps the hosted caller's SDK and records hosted-caller. A control covers both routes, the cross-route refusals and malformed pins, and reverting the selection fails two tests. Lesson: when one runner drives both a published archive and the checked-out source, every toolchain pin must come from the artifact actually built, and a toolchain move (like #829) must be followed by a real run of each route, not only static controls. First fresh run after the repair: source-built 48/48 (16 per Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) on 4f9554d1. Limits: development verification under ADR-0096 only. Open follow-up Templates#847: the unlocked typed-owner build still rewrites tracked packages.lock.json after the clean-tree check, and a missing global.json raises an untyped error.
title: Source-built composition runs must take the SDK from the checked-out template, not the hosted caller
